However, only 3 men proved themselves better on the day; these were the near-invincible Matthews (49.43.6), Ilford's Williams (53.08.1) and Cambridge Harriers' Godbeer (53.20).

By the two-mile stage, two County Champions of the previous week came under the Judges' ban, Arthur Thomson (Mddx) and our own Ray Middleton (Surrey), while others who were disqualified included Godbeer, (Cambridge).
Ray Middleton finished 2nd in 99:46 only 3 secs behind Godbeer of Cambridge. John Knifton finished an excellent fourth and with Ray Hall 7th we easily won the match from Poly and Woodford.

In the Woodford Gn Open '5' on Sept 14th, John Knifton had a great tussle with Clark (Poly) and Godbeer (Camb.).Only 14 seconds covered them at the finish, with honours going to Clark by a 6 seconds margin over John.
